commit.message:
chore: move to pnpm 12.10.1

Every mcp-* repo moves to the latest pnpm together, so the fleet runs one
package manager again; appstore-connect had been alone on 12.5.1. CI and the
Docker build both resolve pnpm from this field (pnpm/action-setup, corepack).

The lockfile grows a leading document: pnpm 12 records its own binary there
(packageManagerDependencies, with integrity hashes per platform), so the
package manager is pinned and verified like any dependency. No dependency
resolved differently. pnpm 12 also refuses unrecognized pnpm-workspace.yaml
settings once the version is pinned; allowBuilds and minimumReleaseAgeExclude
are both recognized. Install, lint, format, typecheck, tests and build pass.
